method: Per-request statistics, separated by physical GPU and original run namespace; no outcome selection.

timing_definitions.input_processing_ms: Host wall from after ensure_prompt to static input staging; excludes ensure_prompt/tokenizer work.
timing_definitions.vision_ms: CUDA Event span around original vision_encoder; includes dispatch gaps, not kernel busy time.
timing_definitions.ae_ms: CUDA Event span for both full18-layer AE iterations and Euler updates; not measured separately per iteration.
timing_definitions.decode_ms: Host wall for raw D2H and output transform.
timing_definitions.model_event_sum_ms: Per-request sum of vision/vlm/ae Event spans.
timing_definitions.request_wall_ms: Server policy wall; includes prompt work, input hashing, other setup/copies/validation; excludes full response serialization and client RPC/network.
timing_definitions.unitemized_request_wall_ms: Per-request request_wall minus five recorded stages; not a directly measured CPU stage or pure compute time.

limitations: Existing closed-loop observations, not fixed-input exclusive performance experiments.
Removing each episode first request is an explicit descriptive view, not proof every remaining sample is fully warm.
Do not add stage medians to obtain request median; sum computed per request.
No pure-kernel time, AE1/AE2 split or exact attribution of unitemized time without new instrumentation.
No GPU experiments, source changes or changes to the frozen original artifacts.
